_comment_version: Do not change the version number! It is used for automatic config updates.
_comment_hud: Enable or disable the on-screen quests HUD.
_comment_hud_alignment: Set to 'left' or 'right' to align the HUD.
_comment_hud_position: X and Y offset for the HUD position on the screen (X=10 and Y=70 is default position).
_comment_scales: Scale modifiers for different GUI elements (1.0 is default size).
